notes: The Create button was not dead because of its name field. toast(...) appeared at 23 call sites in the client and was never written. Every one threw ReferenceError. Those calls sit on the success and failure paths of every cohort mutation — create, delete, edit members, add a symbol, remove a symbol, set a note. So the buttons did not merely fail to confirm: the throw aborted the handler, and on the success paths it aborted *before* the re-render that would have shown the change had landed. A whole tab's worth of controls read as broken, and had since those call sites landed. Why it survived. A
